query:
SELECT
                    u.id,
                    u.username,
                    u.display_name,
                    u.bio,
                    u.avatar_url,
                    u.banner_url,
                    u.created_at,
                    EXISTS(
                        SELECT 1 FROM follows
                        WHERE follower_id = $1 AND following_id = u.id
                    ) AS "is_following!: bool",
                    (u.id = $1) AS "is_current_user!: bool"
                FROM users u
                WHERE u.id != $1
                ORDER BY u.username
